inputs.name: vol_5d_pct
inputs.label: 5-day volatility (%)
inputs.help: Annualised daily high-low range volatility of Reliance over the last 5 days

inputs.name: vol_20d_pct
inputs.label: 20-day volatility (%)
inputs.help: The same measure over the last 20 days

inputs.name: vol_60d_pct
inputs.label: 60-day volatility (%)
inputs.help: The same measure over the last 60 days; the forecast is built around this level

inputs.name: return_20d_pct
inputs.label: 20-day return (%)
inputs.help: Price change over the last 20 trading days

inputs.name: drawdown_pct
inputs.label: Below 6-month high (%)
inputs.help: 0 means at the highest close of the last six months; -10 means 10% below it

inputs.name: volume_ratio
inputs.label: Recent volume vs normal (x)
inputs.help: Average volume of the last 5 days against the 60 days before them

inputs.name: india_vix
inputs.label: India VIX
inputs.help: The market's expected volatility over the next 30 days (index points)
